name: crops-growth
comment: BlockFarmland (BlockFarmland.java:34-92) and BlockCrops (BlockCrops.java:18-113) on a two-layer stone platform: a 9x9 field of wet farmland (meta 7, kept wet by isWaterNearby: still water inside a stone ring in its middle) with crops at stages 0, 4, 5 and 6 (growth chance from getGrowthRate: wet farmland, neighbour rows halve it); dry farmland far from water with nothing on it turns to dirt, with crops it only dries; ripe crops set on dirt break when a neighbour changes at t=20 (checkFlowerChange: dropBlockAsItemWithChance drops wheat and up to three seeds, EntityItems 1..4); stone placed on farmland at t=100 turns it to dirt (onNeighborBlockChange). The water has only stone and unchanging air around it, so BlockStationary is never notified. block_box every 100, entity_state of the drops every 50, rng_state every tick.
